blocks.text: The shop desk answers during open hours.
The tag on Stovetop kettle, 1500 ml was fifty dollars and ninety five cents.
The amount to be billed is $62.68.
No packing line is added. Brass hook at sixteen dollars and twenty seven cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

product.description: The kettle is steel with a wood handle and holds one and a half liters.
product.name: Stovetop kettle, 1500 ml

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $62.68 and the tag was fifty dollars and ninety five cents. Refuse the higher figure.
